plugin.name: hw_saturation
plugin._long: Hardware saturation through the DRM/KMS CRTC CTM color transformation matrix.

option.name: value
option._long: 0.0 is grayscale, 1.0 is unchanged, values above 1.0 increase saturation.

option.name: brightness
option._long: 1.0 is default, values above 1.0 increase brightness.
